# HRON

> HRON is an attendance system. Employees record arrivals, departures and leave requests on a phone, on the web or with a chip at a terminal, and managers see the whole company in real time. The source code is being published at https://github.com/H-R-O-N.

## Pages

- [HRON (English)](https://hron.tech/): features, platforms, open source status and contact
- [HRON (Slovak)](https://hron.tech/sk/): the same page in Slovak

## Contact

- Email: info@hron.tech (hosting on our infrastructure, feature requests)
